name: Pool Gameobject Template
description: Adds every spawn of a gameobject template to a spawn pool at once: all gameobject guids with this entry join the pool with the given chance, instead of listing each guid in pool_gameobject.

fields.name: Id
fields.help: Gameobject template entry; every spawn (guid) of this entry is added to the pool. The guids must not also be listed in pool_gameobject.

fields.name: Pool Entry
fields.help: Pool id from pool_template the spawns belong to.

fields.name: Chance
fields.help: Explicit chance (percent, 0-100) applied to each spawn of this template. Only used when the pool's max_limit is 1; otherwise (or when chance is 0) members are picked with equal probability.
